independenceStatement: Expected per-page outcomes derived ONLY from citation-map.json's known construction + the A1 contract (卷X页Y from non-empty citationVolume/citationPageLabel with isCitable!=false; ambiguity = (citationVolume,citationPageLabel) occurring >1 in a document; non-citable otherwise). INDEPENDENT of harness output (A07-GATE-00 §3 applied to A1). d1: two distinct labels -> clean 卷1页5 (golden) + 卷1页6. d2: (2,3) appears on 2 physical pages -> both ambiguous. d3: isCitable=false -> non_citable; empty citationVolume -> non_citable.
